system.description:
CLASS EXPERT

Your sense of balance is nearly superhuman—even magic trembles at your footing.

Prerequisites Acrobatics 8 ranks

You gain Advantage on checks and saves against being knocked prone or moved. You also ignore the effects of narrow surfaces, unstable footing, or magically shifting terrain when making Acrobatics checks.

Partly automated: a Shove, Trip or Reposition against you is rolled at disadvantage (you roll nothing against it), and advantage is offered as a tick on your own checks and saves against being knocked prone or moved. Ignoring narrow surfaces, unstable footing and magically shifting terrain on Acrobatics checks is the GM's to apply: the system does not yet say what those surfaces change on such a check (see the Block 11 audit, B11-2).

conditionals.scope: Checks and saving throws against being knocked prone or moved — tick if this roll is one
